rec.name: Custom Unit Price Label (Metafield Override)

what.text: The unit price label shown next to the product price, such as "€2,00/item", can be replaced per product with custom text such as "Stück" ("piece"). The price and calculation still come from Shopify's native unit price calculator. Only the label text changes. The override appears on the PDP price row and on the cart drawer line item (e.g. "€19,90/Stück"). If the metafield is empty, the default Shopify label is shown.

why.text: Shopify's unit price measures are fixed (ml, l, m, m², kg, g, "Per item" and so on) and have no "piece" option. German shoppers therefore see the English word "item" in an otherwise German store. A mixed-language label looks unpolished and can reduce trust. A native-language unit label keeps the price easy to understand and the store consistent. The effect is small and mostly hygiene, but it matters for localized stores.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield (definition) named "Unit Price Label" as single-line text. 2) In the theme's unit price snippet, which is used on the PDP price and the cart drawer, output the metafield value if it is present and otherwise fall back to the default Shopify unit measure label. 3) Keep the Shopify unit price calculator enabled (total measure / base measure with unit "Per item") so that the price math is still native. 4) Fill in "Stück" for the relevant products in the product metafields section. The original build was done in the development theme and then merged into the Live theme.

items: Per-product metafield "Unit Price Label" (free text, e.g. "Stück")
Empty value = default Shopify unit label
Native Shopify unit price (total measure, base measure) remains the source of the price value

dependencies.text: Product metafield definition "Unit Price Label" (single-line text). It requires a theme edit to the unit price snippet on the PDP and in the cart drawer. The product must have Shopify's native unit price configured. No app required.

items: PDP conversion rate (should be neutral to slightly positive)
Customer support questions about price or unit labels
Add-to-cart rate on products with unit prices
Number of products with a label override (adoption/coverage)

images.caption: Shopify's "Add unit price" dialog. The unit list (cl, L, m³, mm, cm, m, m², "Per item") has no "piece" option, which is why an override is needed.
Before: the PDP price shows the English default label "€2,00/item" next to the main price.
Admin: the product metafield "Unit Price Label" filled with "Stück".
After: "€19,90/Stück" on the PDP price row and in the cart drawer line item (marked by red arrows).
